purpose: AIMO learns from life while School may also grow compact memory; AIMO uses AgentLife compact_memory_intake queue to avoid direct publish races.

pipes.AgentLife: AIMO LifeLight candidate -> existing compact_memory_intake warehouse with PENDING_MEMORY_ATOM_GATE -> full memory atom acceptance -> READY_AFTER_MEMORY_ATOM_GATE -> locked merge queue

auto_rule: Ordinary LifeLight never blocks cognition on semantic acceptance. It queues a PENDING_MEMORY_ATOM_GATE packet. Merge/maintenance must defer pending packets. A separate governed acceptance pass may promote to READY_AFTER_MEMORY_ATOM_GATE before locked merge.
agent_view: AIMO should treat compact memory as one source-agnostic growing memory and resample memory state at each cycle boundary.
reject_rule: REJECT: existing queue maintenance deletes the bad warehouse packet immediately after full memory atom gate, writes only a bounded anti-repeat feedback digest (max 20) into the existing AgentLife working context when a valid producer context exists, and does not create a second queue, daemon, or long-term rejection memory.
